title: Set Initial Fresh-Project Board to 3 Columns: Backlog -> cvh-dev (Development) -> Ready, with cvh-dev Persona and 200k Context
commitMessage: fix(config): simplify map_or to is_none_or per clippy lint
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Configured initial fresh-project default board to an agile 3-column architecture (Backlog -> cvh-dev / Development -> Ready), bound to cvh-dev persona with 200,000 token context window: (1) Updated scaffold_cvh_project in config.rs, DEFAULT_BOARDS_JSON, and DEFAULT_PIPELINE_JSON to generate 3 columns ('backlog', 'dev' with persona 'cvh-dev', and 'ready' with terminal: true); (2) Added auto-seeding of 200,000 tokens for cvh-dev setting on project scaffold if absent or lower; (3) Updated frontend default board state in boardStore.ts and mockData.ts to match 3-column layout; (4) Updated backend unit test in commands/tests.rs; (5) Resolved clippy::unnecessary_map_or lint by replacing map_or(true, |w| w < 200000) with is_none_or(|w| w < 200000); (6) Formulated Section 2.30 invariant in AGENTS.md; (7) Verified via all NASA Ground Truth Sensors (cargo check, cargo test 116 passed, cargo clippy 0 warnings, npx tsc 0 errors).

caveatsAddressed.caveat: Clippy warning: clippy::unnecessary_map_or on Option::map_or(true, |w| w < 200000)
caveatsAddressed.resolution: Replaced Option::map_or(true, ...) with idiomatic Option::is_none_or(|w| w < 200000) in commit 69dafb3, satisfying clippy in -D warnings mode.

rootCauses.detail: In Rust 1.82+, Option::is_none_or was stabilized to replace .map_or(true, predicate). The initial implementation in config.rs used .map_or(true, |w| w < 200000), which triggered cargo clippy -- -D warnings.
rootCauses.resolution: Simplified to .is_none_or(|w| w < 200000) in commit 69dafb3, passing cargo clippy with 0 warnings.
